author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at what appears to be a rapid amount of progress made on freeing Sony's games away from their systems. We have recomps, ports, emulation and jailbroken systems that are causing people to finally detach their systems from the corporate overlords that control them. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!

title: Sony Really Screwed Up This Time...
